record.Description: This recall involves squishy dumpling and crazy squib ball toys. The squishy dumplings, model 3655, come in multiple translucent colors, containing glitter and water beads. The toys have a cartoon face and are packaged in a tan plastic container shaped like a bamboo steamer. "SQUISHY DUMPLING" is printed on the front of the removable package labeling. There are no markings on the product, other than the cartoon face. The crazy squib balls, model 3984, come in multiple translucent colors, containing glitter and water beads. The toys come individually wrapped in a white netting. "CRAZY SQUIB BALL" and "Squeeze it! Throw it!" are printed on the front of the package labeling.
record.Title: ABC Trading Recalls Squishy Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Water Bead Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys

Products.Name: Squishy Dumpling Toys, Crazy Squib Ball Toys

Images.Caption: Recalled Squishy Dumpling and tan container

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
ABC Trading stores in Los Angeles, California and other stores nationwide from April 2026 through June 2026 for between 41 cents and $1.25.

Importers.Name: ABC Trading Inc., of Vernon, California

Hazards.Name: The squishy toys violate the mandatory safety standard for toys because the water beads inside the toys expand larger than permitted, posing a deadly ingestion hazard. If a water bead is ingested, it can pose ingestion, choking, and intestinal obstruction hazards inside a child's body, resulting in severe discomfort, vomiting, dehydration and a risk of death to a child.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the squishy toys immediately and contact ABC Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" in permanent marker on the squishy toys, throw the toy away and email a photo of the disposed toy to recallabc@gmail.com.

ai.summary: ABC Trading has recalled approximately 37,000 Squishy Dumpling toys (model 3655) and Crazy Squib Ball toys (model 3984) filled with glitter and water beads. The toys violate mandatory safety standards because the internal beads expand beyond allowed limits if swallowed. This expansion can cause choking, intestinal blockages, severe sickness, and potentially fatal injuries in children.
ai.next_steps: Stop using the recalled toys right away. Write "RECALLED" on the toys in permanent marker, throw them in the trash, and email a photograph of the discarded items to recallabc@gmail.com to receive a full refund.
